purpose: Closes the `status:` frontmatter vocabulary for coordinator/docs/wiki/ pages at exactly five values. Synonym spellings (living, current, canonical) are folded into `active`; this file is the target-state contract a lint checks pages against, not a log of edits already made to page bodies.
retired_spelling_precedent: Narrow the live vocabulary; tolerate retired spellings only in an archive reader, never in the live corpus itself (per handoff-archived.schema.json's own resolution of the same question, cited against admitting synonyms here).
